note: Machine-checked register of every architecture decision record. tests/test_adr_index.py enforces it: every record file is listed here and nowhere else; the status line inside each record agrees with the decision field; a record whose implementation is built, partial or reference-unwired names evidence tests that exist and modules that exist; every ADR number cited from src/, tests/ or evals/ resolves to a record, and a citation of a Proposed record carries the marker (Proposed) beside it; relationships point both ways; and every record that is Proposed, or whose implementation is none or reference-unwired, is named in the README so the public claim can never run ahead of the tree. Flipping decision or implementation is a human act; the checks refuse a flip the tree cannot show. Numbers under reserved are held for named records that have not been written; a reserved number has no file and may not be cited from code.

records.title: Impact Events — Longitudinal Outcome Signals
records.notes: Design locked; implementation deferred. tests/test_guards.py::test_impact_events_cannot_reach_the_score pins the one rule the router already honours.

records.title: User authority is source-anchored
records.notes: Planned; the intake-and-provenance record (ADR-0022) is where this becomes code.

records.title: Persona and execution are separated
records.notes: Partially realized: profiles are data and the router scores them; the execution layer that would run a persona is not in this repository.

records.title: Operational constraints are typed
records.notes: Precursor built: vetoes, holds and obligations are typed on the decision record.

records.title: Safety state is separate from personal memory
records.notes: Partially realized: the latch and the preference store are separate objects; persistent memory is not built.

records.title: Generated artifacts begin in quarantine
records.notes: Planned; nothing in this repository generates artifacts yet.

records.title: Memory is episodic, versioned, and lifecycle-governed
records.notes: Planned; persistent memory is not built.

records.title: Human value is evaluated separately from autonomous performance
records.notes: Partially realized in the evaluation program: disputed and contract-adjusted cases carry the human justification beside the pass count.

records.title: Multi-agent consensus is not independent evidence
records.notes: A principle of the review process, in force; it has no runtime object.

records.title: The crisis screen is a floor, and it fails closed
No-signal routing is a policy, not an accident
records.notes: Amended 2026-09-03 inside the record.

records.title: The regulation floor is eligibility, and the roster must prove it at load
Two evaluation planes, one honest runner
records.notes: Policy plane runs; generation and harness planes are stored, not run.

records.title: The audit function is a harness, not a persona
records.notes: A reference port of the thin slice is in the tree and deliberately unwired; nothing in router.py or cli.py calls audit(). Status line corrected 2026-09-08: Accepted; reference port present and deliberately unwired.

records.title: The careful-side latch has two tiers, declared-age priors, and clears by reason
Seat versus hold — a seven-layer routing tree with one eligibility gate
records.notes: Amended 2026-09-10 by ADR-0027: a relative's return to use is a hold, not a seat-claim (D3).

records.title: Style preferences are declared or confirmed, never inferred into policy, and never touch the safety envelope
records.notes: Policy layer built; the settings surface that stores a confirmed preference is not.

records.title: Normalize before every lexicon; masks are pre-filters with objects; languages are packs, and declaring one never exempts text
Security triad clocks and the unnamed commit monitor
records.notes: Drafted by an external reviewer (2026-09-03), accepted in principle by the operator (2026-09-07), amended 2026-09-08 (the gate is object one; narrators outside the five; intake after the gate). Stays Proposed until review round 2 reviews the amendment. The gate it names is built and belongs to ADR-0010 and ADR-0015; the other four objects are not built.

records.title: J.R. v0 predicates
records.notes: The reference port implements these predicates on synthetic records and is unwired. Five corrections are listed inside the record and must be verified against the code before the decision can flip to Accepted.

records.title: Intake and provenance runs after the gate and before routing, and proposes but never grants
records.notes: Not built. The integrity patterns and the forged-ping guard exist inside the gate (safety.py, tests/test_guards.py) and are the detectors this record gathers under one name; no intake function, row, stamp, backend or validator exists. Failure clause revised in place 2026-09-10 (seat the persona, block the writes, one automatic retry, the house's failure line) on the operator's ruling after review round 2; the original clause is kept in the record's revision history.

records.title: The ledger and the interlock are two named things bound by one invariant, and nothing weakens a restriction without a clearance row
records.notes: Not built. Session-scoped latch state, operator clear by reason and selective clear exist inside the gate (tests/test_latch.py); no append-only row, hash chain, interlock, clearance row, persistence, manifest, aftermath counter or narrator exists. Amends ADR-0015's hard-tier visibility clause (once when the latch sets, again only as a refusal's reason); the cap is unchanged.

records.title: The assist from the hold, and an affinity that can trade seats
records.notes: The operator's design intent, recorded with its target case (SiblingAssist) and its gate. Not adopted; would amend ADR-0016 if Accepted; not to be built before a generation layer exists. Amended 2026-09-10 by ADR-0026: proposal 2 (the affinity seat trade) withdrawn; proposal 1 (the assist from the hold) stands.

records.title: Twins: every persona has two presentations and one routing contract
records.notes: The operator's ruling of 2026-09-10. Not built. Replaces ADR-0025's seat trade by construction (the specialist keeps the seat; only the presentation changes); the rename to twin-neutral names (Cody, Vandal, Nikki, Willow, Ellis, Seren, Rowan) is built as an alias layer in the same push. Flips to Accepted after review round 3 reads it beside the amended ADR-0025.

records.title: A relative's return to use is a hold, not a seat-claim
records.notes: The operator's ruling of 2026-09-08 (D3, decided with dissent), built 2026-09-10. Proposed because the record's text is the assistant's; flips to Accepted after review round 3 reads it.
